thread:
may: Kicking off bring-up for asia-southeast cluster, hit a blocker during node pool config — GPUs not being recognized. Anyone on call?
ops-bot: [auto] NodePool 'ae-sg-gpu-1' failed to attach GPUs: capacity mismatch (requested: a100, available: t4). error_code=GPU_CAPACITY_MISMATCH
raj: Can you paste the node startup logs? Did terraform use the right SKU? We had a similar issue where the tf var defaulted to 't4' because of the region mapping.
may: here's kubelet logs from one of the nodes: ```
Feb 20 03:12:12 kubelet[1234]: Failed to register GPU: No devices found
Feb 20 03:12:15 kubelet[1234]: Driver install completed, but no nvidia devices enumerated
```
may: also `az vm show` for vm-id vm-ae-07 shows tags: {"gpu_type":"t4"} even though we requested a100 in the TF vars.
tess: check infra/regions.yaml — I think asia-southeast still has the legacy mapping (gpu_sku: 't4') instead of the new gpu_profile mapping. We need to run `scripts/update-region-mapping --region asia-southeast`. That mapping overrides the tf var through interpolation.
liam: Also saw CNI errors earlier — pods couldn't pull images due to MTU mismatch (1500 vs 1400) on the new VPC. kube-proxy/driver daemonset kept crashing and that blocked driver init.
may: Good catch. Should we rollback the last terraform apply? We already have ~12 nodes provisioned and costs are ramping.
raj: Hold on rollback — if we tear down we lose the current provisioning state (and increases downtime). Proposed plan:
  1) fix region mapping in repo and create a PR
  2) re-run `terraform plan` (no apply yet) to confirm changes
  3) patch VM SKU for affected node pools with `az vm update` (or reprovision small batch)
  4) restart GPU driver DaemonSet and confirm `nvidia-smi` on nodes
  5) run smoke tests and handoff to capacity team
I'll take steps 1-3 now.
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline #1024 started: apply infra/asia-sea mapping patch (author tess) — CI checks: lint ok, plan generated (no destructive changes).
tess: pushing mapping PR now and adding MTU check to the bootstrap runbook. We should also add a pre-handoff validation step: `./tools/gpu-smoke.sh --region=asia-sea` + `./tools/network-check --mtu=1500`.
may: Awesome. @raj @tess please ping once `nvidia-smi` shows GPUs. Tagging @ops to watch cost — we've already seen ~$1.4k in 3 hours unexpectedly :grimacing:.
liam: I'll spin up a small canary workload to confirm scheduling + perf once GPUs are visible.
raj: Update: `az vm update` completed on 6 nodes, kernel driver pods restarted, `nvidia-smi` returns GPUs on 5/6 nodes (one node still pending driver init). investigating the remaining node's system journal now.
may: Thanks — keeping thread open until green + handoff doc updated. Checklist I'm adding to the runbook: region-mapping validation, VM SKU check, MTU verification, GPU smoke, cost guardrail. Will post PR link when ready.
